calculation_handling.description: Indoor amenity space of at least 2.0 m2 per dwelling unit; there is no amenity-space target in the model.

units.disclosure: In the RA zone a lot with 20 or more dwelling units needs at least 2.0 square metres of indoor amenity space per dwelling unit at or above established grade. Amenity space is not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: At least 40.0 m2 of outdoor amenity space adjoining or accessible to the indoor amenity space; there is no amenity-space target in the model.

units.disclosure: In the RA zone a lot with 20 or more dwelling units needs at least 40.0 square metres of outdoor amenity space adjoining or directly accessible to the indoor amenity space. Amenity space is not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: No more than 25 percent of the outdoor amenity component may be a green roof; there is no amenity-space target in the model.

units.disclosure: In the RA zone, for a lot with 20 or more dwelling units, no more than 25 percent of the outdoor amenity component may be a green roof. Amenity space is not modelled.

15.10.40.50(1).explanation: In the RA zone, a lot with 20 or more dwelling units must provide amenity space at 4.0 square metres per dwelling unit, with at least 2.0 square metres per unit indoors, at least 40.0 square metres outdoors, and no more than 25 percent of the outdoor part as a green roof.
